## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for the change, including the failure paths (the SDK fails closed)
- [ ] `mvn verify` passes locally
- [ ] Docs in `docs/` updated where behavior changes
- [ ] A line under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md` if users notice the change
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, tests, logs or examples
